mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and declines in unemployment rate signal aggressive monetary tightening amid labor market strength, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 underperforms as policy rates constrain corporate financing costs, generating negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during monetary tightening cycles (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payroll employment indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals an overheating labor market that triggers premature monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (quarterly GDP growth > 2.0% and RSAFS growth > 5.0%), the S&P 500 underperforms as economic overheating increases recession risks, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal a synchronized demand-supply contraction that reduces near-term corporate revenue visibility, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when HOUST and INDPRO both decline but SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
